title: Manual step markers with operator confirmation
Dispatch parameter forwarding: dynamic values not in parent parameters
description: Dispatch states use parameter_map to forward values to child processes, but currently parameter substitution only resolves declared parameters on the parent instance. The main process (project-main) needs to forward dynamic values like feature_name, bug_summary, question that aren't known at process start. Options: (1) allow transition metadata to feed parameter_map substitution, (2) add a prompt mechanism that collects values at dispatch time, (3) declare all possible child parameters on the parent. Option 1 is probably cleanest.
close_reason: Transition metadata merges with parent parameters for dispatch parameter_map resolution. Extra params take precedence.

title: Execute on_exit actions in engine transition
description: Engine runs on_exit.validations but skips on_exit.actions. The StateHooks model supports actions on both on_enter and on_exit, but engine.transition() only executes on_enter.actions (line 405). on_exit.actions should run after on_exit validations pass, before the state change. Reported by PearlAnchor (excel-to-sdk): they want to auto-run a manifest-update script on state exit.
close_reason: Fixed: on_exit.actions now execute after on_exit validations pass. 3 tests with marker-file fixture.

title: Assertive guard state banner for agent grounding
description: Agents hallucinate process state after compaction. The guard hook fires on every Edit/Write and is the only reliable re-grounding point. Make the guard output more assertive: 'You are in: feature-development @ implement (instance 6f67d5)' instead of a passive status line. Include stale-instance hints when the instance hasn't transitioned recently. Goal: the guard output should be strong enough to override a hallucinated mental model.
close_reason: Shipped: assertive banner + path-scoped edit_paths. 10 new tests, 408 total.

title: Spike: compaction resilience for role context

May involve post-compaction hooks, CLAUDE.md persistence, or compact role context with file pointers for detail.
close_reason: Spike complete. Guard nudge surfaces role on every Edit/Write. Full agent_context via transition result and process_status on demand.
